narrative:
Capex is USD 51.2B in the FY2026 budget against USD 25.6B of DD&A — a reinvestment ratio of about 2.0×. Upstream oil development to hold maximum sustainable capacity is the largest program at USD 20B, followed by gas expansion including Al-Rimal at USD 10B and downstream refining and conversion at USD 8B.

Exploration and appraisal wells are USD 4B, pipelines, terminals and digital USD 5B, and new energies — CCS, blue hydrogen and renewables — USD 3B.

Producing assets deplete on units of production; refineries and pipelines depreciate over 10–25 years.

signals.title: Dividend exceeds free cash flow
signals.excerpt: The FY2026 budget dividend of $83.7B exceeds free cash flow of $60.3B after $51.2B capex; the $23B gap is funded from cash and debt and widens to about $35B at $60 Brent.

signals.title: Gas expansion is the growth engine
signals.source: Meridian Gas Co. — Al-Rimal program review
signals.excerpt: Non-Associated Gas Fields revenue is budgeted 3 points above group growth as the Al-Rimal unconventional program ramps and frees crude for export.
